name: key-ordering
description: Object keys are sorted lexicographically by UTF-16 code unit, regardless of insertion order.

name: unicode-not-escaped
description: Non-ASCII characters are emitted as literal UTF-8 text, not \u-escaped.

name: nested-structures
description: Array element order is preserved; nested object keys are sorted independently at every level.

name: number-formatting
description: Numbers use ES6 Number-to-string form: negative zero collapses to 0, and magnitudes below the exponential thresholds stay in plain decimal.
